the system is able to perform 6DoF tasks with high accuracy and intuitiveness, and that it is able to perform the task without any singularity.
the system is capable of performing 6DoF assembly tasks in the case of negligible time delay and that it is capable of performing tasks with a delay of up to 0.3 seconds.

the development of haptic telemanipulators with dissimilar kinematic structure.
the development of a telemanipulation system with dissimilar kinematic chains for assembly operations.
the development of a haptic telerobotic interface that is capable of performing 6DoF assembly tasks.

the system is capable of performing 6DoF teleoperation tasks.
the telemanipulation in 6DoFs with dissimilar kinematic devices can be successfully performed.

the system can be used for telemanipulation in 6DoFs.

the use of redundant haptic input devices can be very useful in telemanipulation tasks.
a telerobotics system with dissimilar kinematic structures is feasible and can be implemented in a practical way.
